flags.message: Decisive public signal predating the snapshot, used in the forecast (forward cell, not leakage): the petition's sole requested relief is a hold for United States v. Hemani (No. 24-1234) followed by a GVR; Hemani was decided June 18, 2026 against the government and expressly declined to address 922(g)(1). The Solicitor General's identically framed petition in United States v. Mitchell (No. 25-935) was held for Hemani and then denied June 29, 2026, and the related government petitions in Doucet (No. 25-1001) and Cockerham (No. 25-1029) were denied April 27 and June 8, 2026. Hence a forecast far below the federal band's base rate.
